mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource_gc_candidate (resource_id, state, candidate_at, not_before, last_error, updated_at) VALUES (#{resourceId}, 'PENDING', #{candidateAt}, #{notBefore}, NULL, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state = 'PENDING', candidate_at = #{candidateAt}, not_before = #{notBefore}, last_error = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt}
